Both responses give the correct answer of 7.5 hours (7 hours 30 minutes). Both show the same reasoning: the tap fills 1/3 per hour, the drain empties 1/5 per hour, the net rate is 2/15 per hour, and the time is 15/2 hours. Both are well under 120 words.

The only differences are formatting. Response A puts the answer with the conversion up front and lists every step as a bullet. Response B puts the answer up front, bolds the net rate, and states the final computation in a line of its own. These differences are trivial and add no substance, so neither is better in any way that matters.

Verdict: TIE
